script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for May 4. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.

Right now, invisible waves are passing through your body carrying music, conversations, and data.  Radio waves move at the speed of light, pass through walls, and connect devices without any visible link.  We live immersed in invisible signals.

Radio waves don't carry actual sound—they carry patterns that represent sound. A microphone converts air vibrations to electrical signals, which modulate the radio wave. Your receiver reverses the process: wave to electrical signal to speaker vibration to sound. Radio waves are part of the electromagnetic spectrum—the same family as light, X-rays, and microwaves.  They're all made of the same thing, just different frequencies.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: What we can't see can profoundly affect us.  Radio waves prove that invisible forces shape our world.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Invisible Awareness - Sense the Unseen.

Here's your activity: Turn on a radio or stream music wirelessly. Consider: this audio traveled to you on invisible waves, passing through walls and space. Count how many wireless signals you're using today: WiFi, Bluetooth, cellular. You're immersed in invisible communication. This helps you appreciate the invisible infrastructure around you.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about invisible waves carrying sound can be applied to invisible awareness - sense the unseen. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
